{
  "rules": [
    "If sentiment is positive (≥0.2) in recent history, reduce forecast slope to avoid over-optimism.",
    "If forecast is rising sharply after a recent spike, cap the next few days’ increase to prevent overshoot.",
    "When true outcome shows strong mean reversion (e.g., sharp drop after peak), adjust forecast downward by 5–10% for next 3–5 days.",
    "If forecast is consistently above true outcome by >5% over 3–5 days, reduce forecast by 1–2% per day to align with sentiment-driven volatility.",
    "If sentiment is negative (≤0.0) and forecast is rising, pause or reverse the upward trend for 2–3 days to reflect bearish sentiment.",
    "For long-term forecasts (e.g., 30d), if true outcome deviates >10% from forecast, apply a smoothing filter to reduce extrapolation bias.",
    "If sentiment history shows a recent shift from neutral to positive, adjust forecast to reflect gradual upward trend, not abrupt spike."
  ]
}
